source: NSE official corporate filings (XBRL) — Financial Results (Reg 33) + Shareholding Pattern (Reg 31), fetched via the nse python package v3.2.1 hitting nseindia.com / nsearchives.nseindia.com directly. No third-party/paid data used.
data_notes: Field names are standardized (see SCHEMA.md) — mapped from whichever raw XBRL tag that filing's taxonomy vintage uses, so the same field name works across all years/companies.
Any real financial fact not yet in the canonical map is kept under 'other_facts' on the same block rather than dropped — this is a standardized schema, not a lossy one.
Balance sheet and cash flow are only disclosed by SEBI LODR at half-year (Q2) and full-year (Q4/Annual) filings — Q1/Q3 having none is expected, not missing data.
cash_flow under each quarter is YEAR-TO-DATE cumulative as filed (H1 for Q2, full year for Q4/Annual), never single-quarter — see its own 'period' field.
'annual' is the separately-filed AUDITED full-year result, distinct from the Q4 quarterly filing — both kept since they can differ.

fii_holding_pct/dii_holding_pct are summed from category sub-fields whose names vary by taxonomy vintage (including a real SEBI taxonomy typo, 'Catergory', in older filings) — the full raw 'categories' dict is always kept alongside for verification.

dii_holding_pct falls back to summing Mutual Funds/Banks/Insurance/Pension Fund categories individually when a filing has no single 'InstitutionsDomestic' aggregate tag (older filings) — treat as an approximation for those years.
Dividend-per-share, analyst estimates, and peer/sector data are not present — none exist in these 2 official sources (see REQUIRED_FIELDS.md / DATA_SOURCES.md).
Some quarters/annual blocks were back-filled by fill_missing_quarters.py from NSE legacy Financial Results and Integrated Filing- Financials XBRL (see 'source_filing' on those blocks).
